topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: Rain drizzles down, makin' the streets shine like they got their own light. Just had a meet with my buddy, Jackie. Turns out, he's packin' up, movin' to the other side of the map. Told him, I said, "Jackie, you never really leave the city unless the city leaves you first." Funny part, he looked surprised. I ain't surprised. Seen this show before. But he's takin' it hard, didn't see it comin'. I just nodded, lit another smoke, and said, "World's got a funny way of changin' the game right when you think you know the rules." He'll be alright. Gotta keep movin', right? Ain't no room for standin' still in this town.
